channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Crawford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Crawford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:Ainge on Crawford deal:

“We weren't sure what Jordan's role would be going forward, and we had an opportunity to get some assets.”

Danny Ainge on Jordan Crawford, Jan 16, 2014. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
Rivers said of Crawford looking for his shot.

“I want him to be aggressive. Again, I think Jordan, [observers are] looking for him to make a bad offensive play. Paul [Pierce] made one; Kevin [Garnett] made one. Offensive players are going to make a couple bad offensive plays. I thought he made far more good ones than that. I want him to stay aggressive. I thought that [first-quarter drive] could have been a foul, he just went into the trees and couldn’t get out. I don’t want to take away what he can do, that’s very important.”

Doc Rivers on Jordan Crawford, Mar 3, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
Peter Stringer:Doc Rivers on Jordan Crawford:

“We hope he becomes a wild card, a Barbosa in some ways.”

Doc Rivers on Jordan Crawford, Feb 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
Ernie Grunfeld on what changed after acquiring Crawford two years ago from Atlanta:

“Jordan, nothing really changed. He had some good moments, but the way we’re playing now is a lot different than then. Now we’re a defensive oriented team and our numbers especially over the last 20 games have shown that we’re one of the top defensive teams in the league. The ball movement has been really good recently and that’s helped us win some games. The players are playing the right way and trying to execute. They’ve been supportive of one another and it just seems like it wasn’t the perfect fit for Jordan at this time.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Jordan Crawford, Feb 22, 2013. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
Michael Lee:Ernie Grunfeld on Crawford:

“He hasn’t been the happiest person, but he’s a good player & we wish him luck in his new situation.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Jordan Crawford, Feb 21, 2013. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Randy Wittman on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
He’s taken that responsibility to heart in the first few days of training camp at George Mason University, so much so that Coach Randy Wittman made sure to mention how much the third-year player has stood out in practice.

“It’s the three best in a row [from Crawford] that I’ve ever seen,”

Randy Wittman on Jordan Crawford, Oct 3, 2012. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Jordan Crawford
item.description:
From coach Flip Saunders‘ perspective, it’s a pretty bright picture.

“This has been a great opportunity for Jordan and for both of those guys, especially playing together these last 20 games,”

Flip Saunders on Jordan Crawford, Apr 8, 2011. Source: Washington Times.
